description: The bar chart titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment" compares the runtime performance of different models in seconds, with the y-axis representing runtime and the x-axis listing the models: "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude." The chart includes two categories of models: "Our Joint Framework" (represented by a dark green bar) and "LLM Models" (represented by light blue bars). The runtime for "Our Joint Framework" is 77 seconds, which is significantly lower than all the LLM models. Among the LLM models, "DeepSeek" has the highest runtime at 365 seconds, followed by "Claude" at 243 seconds, "ChatGPT" at 190 seconds, and "LLaMA" at 172 seconds. The chart clearly illustrates that "Our Joint Framework" outperforms all LLM models in terms of runtime efficiency in a streaming environment.
